title: Record group
description: A named group of record types on the home page and the Records screen. Record types in no group are listed under Other.

hidden.description: Left out of menus and Home, with record types only in this group. Changed on the Modules screen

onHome.description: Show the group's card on Home. Default true; false keeps it off Home until a person pins one of its lists

recordTypes.description: Record types in the group, in order; a record type in several groups shows in the first
